610d1b9c-5e05-4d34-a5f3-772fdb1caa21.author: anon-8ea7a055
610d1b9c-5e05-4d34-a5f3-772fdb1caa21.content: Root cause mapped (investigation agent). The loss is NOT hub state wiping SQLite - it is hydrate_from_state's own restore pass. Sequence inside one transaction (src/hydration.rs:380-414): (1) clear_shared_data deletes issues; (2) hydrate_state_issues INSERT OR REPLACEs the new issue at reduced-state id (starts at 1 on post-import hubs, compaction.rs:861-935 seeded from checkpoint.rs:61 - SQLite never consulted for ID allocation); (3) restore_sqlite_only_issues (hydration.rs:900-923) re-inserts imported SQLite-only rows LAST, also INSERT OR REPLACE - colliding primary key REPLACEs (deletes) the just-created row. Success message prints after (create.rs:465) from the reduced-state map. Event IS durable on the agent ref (core.rs:679-683) - issue survives in hub, invisible locally. Loss self-heals once next_display_id passes the imported max. Fix: restore pass must never REPLACE an id occupied by a reduced-state row - re-key colliding preserved rows to negative local ids (existing offline convention, hydration.rs:472-477).

bf78c2b6-140b-440b-9ce6-6ef29ad3766e.content: DIAGNOSIS CORRECTED by code trace before filing. The original stale-genesis premise is WRONG: SyncManager::fetch on a v2 hub routes to fetch_v2_readonly (sync/cache.rs:298-320) which fetches AND resets the cache worktree to the remote tip, and the migrate dispatcher calls it (migrate_hub_v3.rs:87) before build_genesis_from_files - mdatron's 08:32 genesis therefore INCLUDED 79Ig's 08:18-08:20 work (backup pre-counts at ~08:21 already showed 76/204, and remigrate re-derived the identical 76/204 genesis). The finalize refusal was caused by MY three post-migration lock releases: verify_against_files (migrate_hub_v3.rs:1118) requires reduce(all v3 refs) == genesis (check 2), an invariant only valid at migration time; at finalize (called at :1479 with a same-moment rebuilt genesis, making the v2-freshness check vacuous) ANY legitimate v3 event permanently blocks finalize. Real defect: finalize reuses the migration-time invariant; soak-then-finalize as documented is impossible. Fix shape: at finalize verify v2 files still reproduce the stored/watermarked genesis AND reduce(refs up to the seeded watermark) == genesis, instead of reduce(everything) == genesis.

abd7256f-8458-4ff5-8387-f6d2101069e4.author: anon-8ea7a055
abd7256f-8458-4ff5-8387-f6d2101069e4.content: False-pause bug found during scaffolding verification: check_control_flags() in resources/claude/hooks/work-check.py invokes bare 'crosslink agent flags --strict' via PATH lookup instead of find_crosslink_binary(). With an older binary on PATH (0.8.0, which lacks the 'agent flags' subcommand), clap exits 2 for the usage error - the same exit code the hook treats as pause/kill flags set. Empty stdout then fails JSON parse, state={}, and the hook reports AGENT PAUSED with no operator involved. Evidence: 0.8.0 'crosslink agent flags --strict' -> 'error: unrecognized subcommand', exit 2; 0.9.0-beta.1 -> valid JSON, exit 0. Fix: resolve binary via find_crosslink_binary() AND only treat exit 2 as pause/kill when stdout parses as flag-state JSON, else fail open. Local workaround applied to this clone's .claude/hooks/work-check.py. Upstream fix should target crosslink/resources/claude/hooks/work-check.py and the tracked .claude/hooks/work-check.py copy. Also noticed: init --update leaves .claude/skills/ and .crosslink/init-manifest.json untracked - candidates for .gitignore upstream.

9c3e131d-b757-49dc-b699-6e351e98d1ec.author: anon-8ea7a055
9c3e131d-b757-49dc-b699-6e351e98d1ec.content: #59 ROOT-CAUSED and links to #55. run.rs local branch (:203) passes opts.skip_permissions/permission_mode to launch_local -> build_agent_launch_command emits 'claude{skip_flag}'. Container branch (:241) calls launch_container(mode,worktree,root,image,agent_id,model,allowed_tools,timeout,protected_doc) - does NOT pass the permission flags, and launch_container (launch.rs:666) neither takes nor emits them. Meanwhile container.rs:454 (standalone 'container start') DOES hardcode --dangerously-skip-permissions. => kickoff run --container launches claude with NO permission flag -> claude prompts every tool -> headless container (no TTY) blocks forever = the #55 stall signature exactly. FIX (fix/59-kickoff-container-no-prompt): thread skip_permissions/permission_mode into launch_container and emit the flag on the container's claude invocation, matching launch_local + container start. This is a strong #55 candidate cause for the container path (with #31 already fixed on develop and #9 C-toolchain the other tracked contributor).
